table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	department = dbo.department.name, 
	issueinvcode = dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode, 
	date = dbo.issueheader.date,   
	looseqty = SUM(issuedetail.qty),
	referenceno=ISNULL(issuetype.name + CASE issueheader.issuetypecode WHEN NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' END + dbo.issueheader.referenceno, ''),
	class = ISNULL((select itemclass.name from itemclass where itemclass.iccode = item.iccode), ''),
	dbo.issueheader.referencedate,
	itempacking = itempacking.name
FROM 
	issueheader, 
	issuedetail, 
	issuetype,
	item LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking ON ( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
	department
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.issueheader.referenceno = :ar_refno) AND
	( dbo.issueheader.issuetypecode = :ar_issuetypecode ) AND
	( dbo.issueheader.issuetypecode = issuetype.issuetypecode ) AND
	( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode) AND
	( dbo.issueheader.deptcode = dbo.department.deptcode ) AND
	( dbo.issuedetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)

GROUP BY
	dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode,
	dbo.issueheader.date,
	dbo.issueheader.referencedate,
	dbo.issueheader.referenceno,
	dbo.issueheader.issuetypecode,
	issuetype.name,
	department.name,
	item.iccode,
	itempacking.name

ORDER BY 
	dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode,
	class,
	itempacking
